title: See Through Inv
description: See Through the Inventory with this TP/RP.
body: [Clear Inventory](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clear-inventory) only works for newer Minecraft Versions, because it has the new Textures, that don't work well in old Minecraft... so I did a Texture Pack/Resource Pack that make a "Clear Inventory" for older Versions of Minecraft. ![Here is a Phote of the see through Inv](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62dbbba971acd51f1bfffcd7988f48d9c74dcb2d_0.webp)(Made for 1.8.9, but could work in more Versions)
